Aviation Fuel Prices Rise, Impacting Airline Stocks

Domestic airlines are facing a second consecutive increase in Aviation Turbine Fuel (ATF) prices, with rates rising by 5.46%. This surge in fuel costs is expected to impact the prospects of aviation stocks. The increase in ATF prices is linked to a rise in crude oil prices. The Free Press Journal and The Economic Times reported on this development.
